messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw duplicated webhook deliveries from sampleapp after a 429 during token rotation. Two identical downstream POSTs within ~2s.

maria: Repro steps I used: 1) start sampleapp with local tokens 2) force token refresh 3) hit /generate with high concurrency until we get 429s.

maria: Relevant code in the client retry wrapper:
```js
// simplified
await fetch(apiUrl, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
  .then(res => { if (res.status === 429) throw new Error('TOO_MANY'); return res.json() })
  .catch(() => retry())
```

maria: The issue looks like: the SDK emits an early ack to the webhook handler before the client finishes safe-replay checks, so downstream sees two POSTs.

aj: Thanks for catching. Do you have request IDs for the two POSTs? Also which SDK (node/go/python) did you run?

maria: Request IDs: xreq_1ab23 and xreq_1ab24. Running Node SDK (v0.11.3) sampleapp. Haven't tried Go yet.

samir: Sounds like an unsafe-replay on the client side. Node SDK's streaming resume sends an implicit retry if the connection resets during token rotation. We need parity with other SDKs: Go/Py should expose a replay guard.

kevin: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: add jitter + idempotency key header for webhook delivery. If upstream honors `Idempotency-Key` we won't double-apply. Also tighten the early-ack timing.

maria: Quick trace snippet from the webhook receiver:
```
2026-03-20T18:12:10.123Z Received POST id=xreq_1ab23 payload_len=842
2026-03-20T18:12:11.987Z Received POST id=xreq_1ab24 payload_len=842
```

kevin: That 1.8s gap matches a retry after token refresh + immediate resend. The client probably retried without checking whether the original request completed on the server.

aj: Proposal: Node SDK adds a small replay window + a server-ack handshake for streaming requests. Also ensure the retry logic uses randomized exponential backoff (jitter).

natalie: I started a draft PR with a `safeReplay` opt-in flag for sampleapp. It adds `Idempotency-Key` and waits for a final status before acking. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/123 (draft).

maria: Nice. Can we also add a quick test in the end-to-end suite that injects a 429 during token rotate to assert no duplicate webhook calls?

samir: Yes, I'll add a harness that simulates token expiry mid-request and asserts single-delivery. I'll try to push by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy started for sampleapp/edge (sha: b7e2f3a) — canary to 10%

kevin: Long-term we should formalize SDK parity requirements for replay behavior in the devex checklist — Node/Go/Py must implement the same guardrails.

maria: For immediate ops: I've disabled aggressive client-side early-acks in the demo env and added idempotency header in our webhook sender. Monitoring alerts set for duplicate delivery >1 in 30s.

aj: Thanks all — follow-ups: samir adds e2e test, natalie finishes PR, kevin adds checklist item, maria monitors. I'll sync with the DX doc after fixes land. :thumbsup:
